registry_server.description: CREATE SOMETHING governed LinkedIn Data API MCP wrapper over RapidAPI with D1 and Braintrust telemetry

dify_studio_steps: Create an HTTP MCP server card with server ID linkedin.
Configure bearer auth from Infisical prod:/linkedin-mcp:LINKEDIN_MCP_API_KEY.
Import config/dify/agents/linkedin.yml after the MCP tools are available.
Dify app API key is stored at Infisical prod:/dify/linkedin-agent:DIFY_LINKEDIN_AGENT_API_KEY.
The app is registered in config/dify/agents/registry.json.
Transcribe every discovered tool into config/dify/inventory.json with risk classification.
Run pnpm dify:inventory:generate and pnpm dify:coverage:generate.
notes: This is a separate governed wrapper from Spotify and Active Jobs.
The importable Dify DSL lives at config/dify/agents/linkedin.yml.
The imported Dify app is tracked as linkedin in config/dify/agents/registry.json.
The tool names match RapidAPI Hub - Real-Time LinkedIn Scraper API.
Keep secret values in Infisical only; this artifact stores references, not values.
